description: Parking Restrictions is a dataset listed in City of Bloomington open data portal (data.bloomington.in.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Bloomington. This layer contains on street parking restrictions as stated in the City of Bloomington, Indiana Municipal Code or by temporary order from the City Engineer. The parking restrictions are recorded by restriction type which include: Bus Zone, Combination Parking Zones with multiple restrictions, No Parking Anytime, No Parking Posted Times, and Time Restricted Parking. Coverage: Bloomington, Indiana. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are gis, street department, parking enforcement, restrictions, parking. The table has 11 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-05 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bloomington-in-gov-portal.
